name: Tinker Town
summary: Tinker Town is where gnomes make their home in exile beneath Ironforge. Since Gnomeregan fell, it has been the seat of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque’s government and the Ironforge end of the Deeprun Tram.

sections.title: A Home in Exile
sections.body:
Tinker Town shelters the gnomes who fled Gnomeregan. Troggs overran their high-tech city, so Ironforge’s dwarves opened their gates. They gave the refugees a cavern once used by dwarves, where the Deeprun Tram entrance already stood. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and his council lead the gnomes from here.

Around a massive spherical contraption, the gnomes have rebuilt a semblance of their civilization. Gears whir, alchemy is tested, and gadgets take shape in the cramped district. Though guests in a stone city, the gnomes remain determined to reclaim their subterranean homeland.

sections.title: Subway and Secrets
sections.body: Tinker Town holds the Ironforge entrance to the Deeprun Tram. The engineering wonder carries travelers swiftly between the dwarven capital and Stormwind, joining the two cities.

faq.q: Why are gnomes living in Ironforge instead of their own city?
aliases: why do gnomes live in ironforge
faq.answer: Gnomeregan fell when primitive troggs invaded, and the gnomes evacuated. They fought the troggs alone rather than burdening the Alliance during the Third War. King Magni Bronzebeard offered Ironforge as a sanctuary, where High Tinker Mekkatorque established a temporary capital in exile.

faq.q: What is the Deeprun Tram entrance doing here?
faq.answer: The Deeprun Tram connects Ironforge directly to Stormwind City. Gnomes and dwarves built it together, and its Ironforge terminus opens into Tinker Town. The tram links the two Alliance capitals with swift travel.

angles.text: As a gnome, Tinker Town is the heart of your people in exile. Amid clanking prototypes and fellow survivors, High Tinker Mekkatorque directs efforts to reclaim Gnomeregan.
For an engineer, Tinker Town is an essential stop in Ironforge. Specialized trainers, gadget vendors, parts, and the Deeprun Tram are all here.
